title: Full pi subshell magnetism
statement:
How many unpaired electrons does a fully occupied doubly degenerate π set contain?

[_]{a}

explanations: A set with three electrons would give one.
Two electrons in a degenerate pair can be unpaired.
A single orbital cannot hold two parallel-spin electrons.

hints: Each orbital holds an opposite-spin pair.
solution: There are two separate orbitals. Full occupancy means four electrons. Each orbital holds an opposite-spin pair. Both orbitals are paired.
